headline: Frontier Behavioral Health expands service footprint with new joint clinic and crisis response capabilities

signals.category: New clinic opening (joint venture with CHAS Health)
signals.summary: Frontier Behavioral Health broke ground on a new downtown Spokane clinic in partnership with CHAS Health, offering integrated healthcare and addiction services for low-income patients. This represents material geographic and service expansion for the organization.
signals.suggestedAction: Reach out to Frontier's compliance/IT leadership to confirm email and data security requirements for the new clinic location; offer a brief compliance readiness conversation covering HIPAA mail handling and DLP policies for the expanded operation.
